top_news.title: Margin-Regularized Structured Semantic Alignment for Brain-Language Correspondence
top_news.dek: MD-SigLIP aligns brain and text embeddings to improve the interpretability of neural decoding.
top_news.brief: Researchers introduced MD-SigLIP, a margin-regularized framework designed to address ambiguity in brain-language decoding. By directly aligning neural representations with text embeddings in a shared semantic space, the method aims to distinguish between genuine brain-derived content and reconstructions generated by language models.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the alignment of brain and text embeddings in a shared semantic space.

top_news.title: Flock Has a Powerful New AI Tool for Police. We Got Its Code
top_news.dek: WIRED analysis reveals Flock Safety's new AI surveillance tools exceed simple license plate tracking.
top_news.brief: A technical reconstruction of Flock Safety's latest AI system indicates it possesses capabilities beyond the vehicle-tracking features previously disclosed to the public. The findings suggest the platform can perform more granular identification and tracking, contradicting earlier company claims regarding individual privacy.
top_news.image_alt: A digital illustration depicting surveillance technology and AI agent monitoring.

top_news.title: [AINews] Memory prices up 500% in 12 months
top_news.dek: Memory prices have surged 500% over the past year, creating a significant bottleneck for AI hardware scaling.
top_news.brief: The ongoing memory shortage has caused prices to climb to 10x their historical lows, with 128GB of DDR5 now reaching $3,399. This supply constraint persists despite rapid advancements in specialized AI hardware, such as the Etched double-unicorn valuation and Cerebras's new CS4 system.
top_news.image_alt: Chart showing the sharp upward trend in memory hardware costs over 12 months.
